summary: SABESP and EMAE filed a material fact announcing management will assess the feasibility of SABESP incorporating all EMAE shares not already held. The transaction would be a share-for-share exchange under Brazilian Law 6,404/76; exchange ratio to be set by independent committees. The goal is to make EMAE a wholly owned subsidiary, simplifying corporate structure and reducing costs. No price, premium, or timetable stated. This is a preliminary feasibility study, not a definitive agreement. Watch for independent committee formation, exchange ratio negotiation, and shareholder approvals. Risk-arb to monitor once terms emerge.
